en.text: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

zhSimplified.text: 我曾说：我要谨慎我的言行，

zhTraditional.text: 我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行，

en.text: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

zhSimplified.text: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口；

zhTraditional.text: 我默然無聲，連好話也不出口；

en.text: My heart was hot within me. the fire burned. with my tongue:
“LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. me know how frail I am.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你叫我晓得我身之终！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你叫我曉得我身之終！

en.text: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. every man stands as a breath.”

zhSimplified.text: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；

zhTraditional.text: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；

en.text: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

zhSimplified.text: 世人行动实系幻影。 ，不知将来有谁收取。

zhTraditional.text: 世人行動實係幻影。 ，不知將來有誰收取。

en.text: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Deliver me from all my transgressions. me the reproach of the foolish.

zhSimplified.text: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯，

zhTraditional.text: 求你救我脫離一切的過犯，

en.text: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

zhSimplified.text: 因我所遭遇的是出于你，

zhTraditional.text: 因我所遭遇的是出於你，

en.text: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

zhSimplified.text: 求你把你的责罚从我身上免去；

zhTraditional.text: 求你把你的責罰從我身上免去；

en.text: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. is but a breath.”

zhSimplified.text: 你因人的罪恶惩罚他的时候， 消灭，如被虫所咬。

zhTraditional.text: 你因人的罪惡懲罰他的時候， 消滅，如被蟲所咬。

en.text: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，

en.text: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
